name: N.B.S. Parallel Computer Benchmark Collection
description: A collection of benchmark programs designed to evaluate the performance and behavior of parallel computer systems across workloads.
evaluation_method: execution time, speedup, scalability (strong/weak scaling), throughput and efficiency metrics
general_score_metric: execution time / speedup (and derived efficiency metrics)
reputation: A classic collection of parallel benchmark programs referenced historically in parallel/HPC research; useful as an early-era standard though superseded in many areas by newer suites.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark suite from the 1980s; may not reflect modern parallel workloads or architectures. Useful for historical comparison and algorithmic studies but limited for representing current HPC/heterogeneous systems.
